copy.Takt, proje ihtiyacına göre farklı sektö: Takt brings together technical specialists from different sectors according to each project’s needs, while Ömer Faruk Top coordinates the process as the main technical point of contact.
copy.İhtiyaca göre doğru uzmanlıklar aynı pro: The right expertise comes together around the needs of each project.
copy.Takt Danışmanlık; özel makina, Ar-Ge, ür: Takt Consulting complements the engineering capacity companies need in custom machinery, R&D, manufacturing and technical transformation projects. From defining the need through design, analysis, manufacturing coordination and field implementation, there is one clear point of contact; even when the work spans multiple disciplines, communication and technical coordination continue through a single channel.
copy.Takt her projeye sabit bir ekip şemasıyl: Takt does not approach every project with a fixed team structure. We assess the scope, workload and required expertise, connect the client with experienced technical specialists from different sectors, and assemble a team suited to the project. The right specialists join the process according to the need for design, analysis, manufacturing, automation, field implementation or project management.
copy.KURUCU · DOĞRUDAN MUHATABINIZ: FOUNDER · YOUR DIRECT POINT OF CONTACT
copy.Ömer Faruk Top, Takt’ın kurucusu ve proj: Ömer Faruk Top is the founder of Takt and the client’s main technical point of contact throughout each project. He has worked in project coordination, product development and technical team management across engineering projects of different scales and sectors. At Takt, he is responsible for clarifying the need, identifying the required expertise, bringing the right technical specialists into the project and coordinating the process with the client.

copy.Takt Danışmanlık, Ar-Ge projelerindeki t: Takt Consulting is an engineering team that works to solve technical problems and optimize systems in R&D projects. It provides services in a wide range of areas from system design to facility management in special machinery projects; We bring our past project experience and reverse engineering know-how to every job. Our approach is simple: to bring a measurable rhythm to messy or blocked processes, to complete the missing link in the technical teams of companies, and to maintain the right tempo while turning the idea into production and the problem into a solution.
